sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B | NVIDIA NGC
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a 27-billion-parameter dense vision-language model for text, image, and video understanding, coding, multimodal reasoning, long-context processing, tool calling, and agentic tasks.

sources.title: trevest/Clef-LoRA-for-Qwen3.8-27B-MLX · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: What this repo is: a LoRA adapter for Qwen3.8-27B plus Clef's decision head and a small server, not a standalone model. Put it on any Qwen3.8-27B MLX checkpoint and one resident copy of the weights serves both Cloudflare Clef (decisions) and normal chat.

sources.title: Clef - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Clef is a 27B multimodal decision model that takes a state (text, JSON, images or video) plus a schema of typed questions and returns calibrated probabilities for each allowed answer instead of generating text. Built on a frozen Qwen3.8 27B backbone with rank 256 adapters, it scores all valid choices in parallel after a single prefill pass. It has a 64k context window, a median latency of 209 ...

sources.snippet: Qwen 3.8-27B is Alibaba's compact, deployment-friendly model in the new Qwen 3.8 generation. It is a 27 billion parameter dense model, built on the Qwen3.5 architecture, and it is the direct successor to Qwen 3.6-27B, one of the most-used local coding models on this site.
